tg.conclusion: Reviewed 0.47.0-0.53.0: messages list --limit pages past 100 and carries poll results; comment paging reports hasMore correctly; --source takes account lists and groups; the shared store upgrades (facts table, project keys, label review); macOS folders move to the Linux paths; purging an account drops people only it had seen; date:>= colon comparisons parse; tasks gain plans, links and an agenda with the follow-ups skill; search hits return an excerpt (--full for the whole text) and --brief/--full work everywhere; tg schedule runs a command or a read-only agent on a timer; TG_READ_ONLY=1 refuses every write; store fetch is renamed messages sync; one error object with details and --debug; the store and speech models move to the WireCat folder; tg no longer picks a profile and stops with exit code 2; HTML files are read as their main text; machine output keys are snake_case; defaultProfile can be set without a profile and MCP entries name the profile. Roadmap unchanged: several photos in one message, private chat notes and the max-only features remain planned; none of them shipped.

max.conclusion: Reviewed 0.45.5-0.49.0: chat joins and contact imports count toward sendsPerHour; search fixes cross-account server results and accepts account groups in --source; macOS folders move to the Linux paths; tasks gain plans, links and an agenda; date:>= comparisons parse; search hits return an excerpt (--full for the whole text) and --brief/--full work everywhere; max schedule runs a command or a read-only agent on a timer; MAX_READ_ONLY=1 forbids every send; store fetch is renamed messages sync; one error object with details; shared archive and speech models move to the WireCat folder; max no longer picks a profile itself and stops with exit code 2. Roadmap unchanged: optional local copy, event-triggered actions, round videos, cloud password management and standalone installers remain planned; max schedule runs on a timer, not on a new message.

zm.conclusion: Reviewed Zoom 0.10.0 on Core 0.267.0/Base 0.27.2: account-scoped bounded participant observations, literal Unicode names, byte preflight, page-local ambiguity and standard CLI/MCP continuation; JSONL retains full pages. Meeting lists use metadata queries, string IDs and shared entities instead of list-only date flags. Native incoming anchors are now included in the release, so the three old guide overrides are retired. Reviewed a manual project-name/alias workflow before confirmed membership; automatic alias expansion, dedicated reviewed findings intake and verified-occurrence preparation remain planned. Setup/scopes/callback and semantic delivery rules are unchanged.
